gamerule.propwash.players_create_zones.d: On: every player can mark zones with the Zone Marker and change or delete their own zones. Off: only operators create, change and delete zones; zones that players created before keep working.
propwash.help.zone_marker.summary: Marks a zone with two corners
propwash.help.zone_marker.use.5: without corners: open the zone menu.
propwash.help.zone_marker.what.1: Creates a zone with its own drone rules,
propwash.help.zone_marker.what.2: e.g. infinite battery on a practice field.
propwash.zones_open.edit.tooltip.locked: Locked by the server: %s is set to release “Fixed” in the World Rules tab. The value stays saved but does not apply – it works again once the rule is released.
propwash.zones_open.jump.denied: Only players who may use /tp can teleport to zones
propwash.zones_open.jump.no_ground: No free ground to land on in or below zone “%s”
propwash.zones_open.marker.denied: On this server only operators may create zones
propwash.zones_open.marker.first: First corner at %s %s %s – now right-click the opposite corner
propwash.zones_open.marker.no_target: Look at a block (up to 64 blocks away)
propwash.zones_open.menu.about: Zones change the simulation only for drones inside them, for example infinite battery on the practice field or a zero-gravity passage on a race course. Race-legal zones do not count as assisted. Create new zones with the Zone Marker (right-click two corners); sneak + right-click with the marker opens this tab. “Show” highlights the zone in the world with direction and distance, “Teleport” takes you there (if you may use /tp). Operators decide in the World Rules tab which rules zones may change and can also use /propwash zone.
propwash.zones_open.menu.empty_own: You have no zones in this dimension yet.
propwash.zones_open.menu.footer: Zones belong to the world: “Delete” applies at once, “Apply” in the zone editor saves changes.
propwash.zones_open.menu.footer_read_onl: Read only: on this server only operators create and change zones.
propwash.zones_open.menu.intro.admin: All zones in this dimension with their owner. As an operator you can change and delete every zone.
propwash.zones_open.menu.intro.locked: Players may not create or change zones on this server (world rule “Players may create zones” is off). Your zones keep working.
propwash.zones_open.menu.intro.player: Your zones in this dimension. Only operators see other players' zones here.
propwash.zones_open.menu.intro.unknown: The server reports no zones – it doesn't run Propwash or the connection is still loading.
propwash.zones_open.menu.view.show.toolt: Only with tool: zone outlines appear while you hold the Zone Marker or the Course Tool, while you edit a zone and after “Show”. With tool or in flight: also while you fly a drone, in FPV and line of sight. Always: you see them all the time. Overlapping zones only show their edges; the zone you are in is highlighted.
propwash.zones_open.msg.locked: %s locks %s for zones – zones keep their value but no longer apply it
propwash.zones_open.release.blocked_kept: Zones that already set the rule keep their value but don't apply it while the rule is locked.
propwash.zones_open.release.capable: On: zones may set their own value for %s. Off: the zone editor no longer offers the rule.
propwash.zones_open.release.incapable: Zones can't change %s – the rule always applies to the whole world.
propwash.zones_open.release.title: May be changed by zones
propwash.zones_open.section.blocked: Grey values are locked by the server (release “Fixed” in the World Rules tab): they stay saved but don't apply.
